actor Tracker {
  var active = 0
  var peak = 0
  var completed = 0
  func work(_ item: Int) async {
    active += 1
    peak = max(peak, active)
    try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 50_000_000)
    active -= 1
    completed += 1
  }
  func report() -> (Int, Int) { (peak, completed) }
}

// CASE group_operation_label expect=pass
func runGroup(_ items: [Int], tracker: Tracker) async {
  await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for item in items {
      group.addTask(operation: {
        await tracker.work(item)
      })
    }
  }
}

// CASE task_operation_capture expect=pass
func launch(_ items: [Int], tracker: Tracker) -> [Task<Void, Never>] {
  var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(Task(operation: { [tracker] in
      await tracker.work(item)
    }))
  }
  return tasks
}

// CASE generic_task_apostrophe_comment expect=pass
func launchTyped(_ items: [Int], tracker: Tracker) -> [Task<Void, Never>] {
  var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(Task<Void, Never> {
      // Don't wait here; the caller joins later.
      await tracker.work(item)
    })
  }
  return tasks
}

// CASE harness expect=fire
@main
struct Main {
  static func main() async {
    let a = Tracker()
    await runGroup([1, 2, 3, 4], tracker: a)
    let b = Tracker()
    for task in launch([1, 2, 3, 4], tracker: b) { await task.value }
    let c = Tracker()
    for task in launchTyped([1, 2, 3, 4], tracker: c) { await task.value }
    let (pa, ca) = await a.report()
    let (pb, cb) = await b.report()
    let (pc, cc) = await c.report()
    print("groupOperation peak=\(pa), completed=\(ca)")
    print("taskOperation peak=\(pb), completed=\(cb)")
    print("typedComment peak=\(pc), completed=\(cc)")
    if pa != 4 || pb != 4 || pc != 4 || ca != 4 || cb != 4 || cc != 4 { fatalError("not concurrent") }
  }
}
